aliases: talking to animals with the mind
facts.text: I used to be able to communicate with animals telepathically.
My health is failing: I can't communicate with animals telepathically anymore.

facts.item: failing health: what I think causes it
facts.text: I believe the current weather conditions are affecting it.
This has been going on for the past eight months.
I don't have any other physical complaints or symptoms.
I've started taking assorted Peruvian herbs.
Other than the herbs, I don't take any medications.
I don't have any significant medical history.
I work at a health food store.

source_issues: Social_History mixes observer findings (burlap clothing, attempts at telepathy during history taking) with social facts.
notes: Psychiatric case: facts give what the patient believes (he used to communicate telepathically with animals; his health is failing because he no longer can; the weather is affecting it), not labels such as 'magical thinking'.
The chief complaint (the belief) and the History's 'failing health' are both opening facts (f001, f002); the eight-month duration and the weather attribution are children of the failing health.
Burlap clothing and attempts at telepathic communication during the interview are observer-only signs already in the exam (x001, x002), so they are not patient facts and no acting note is added.
The mental status exam subsections are one record (x002), as a doctor requests a mental status examination as one step.
The gold word 'personality' is kept out of patient texts and items.

extras.objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with unusual behavior and beliefs regarding telepathic communication with animals.
